sources.citation: Durieux, Jude A., Evelin I. K. Durieux-Boon & Angela Kluge. 2011. A sociolinguistic survey of the Ede language communities of Benin and Togo, Volume 6: Kura language area. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2011-007, 46 pp.
sources.note: The only Kura-specific publication; a sociolinguistic report, so a stress statement is unlikely, but it may carry a tone-marked Kura word/phrase list and a one-line note on transcription. PDF blocked by an automated-access block by automated download; a browser download from the landing page should work.

sources.citation: Kluge, Angela. 2011. A sociolinguistic survey of the Ede language communities of Benin and Togo, Introduction and Volume 1: Ede language family - Background and assessment methodology. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2011-002, xi+209 pp. Dallas: SIL International.
sources.note: Nothing on stress. Sec. 4 'Nago' (p. 5) locates Kura Nago at Alédjo-Koura, Pélébina, Sèmèrè; Kura wordlists (Awotébi, Partago) in Appendix L (pp. 81 ff.) carry tone marks, but fn. 36 (p. 81): 'Tone markings were transcribed but were not included in the analysis due to ambiguities in proper weighting.' 'stress' does not occur in a phonological sense.
